packet.prompt:
Read only the supplied manuscript images. Do not search for the text, open a
catalogue or edition, or consult an earlier transcription. Do not identify the
work or author. If prior context has already revealed a proposed identification
or reading, stop and report that exposure instead of calling this a blind reading.

Begin with a brief image-only layout survey. Note orientation, columns, running
titles, rubrics, enlarged initials, underlined text, and interlinear or marginal
glosses when visible. Distinguish observations from tentative interpretations
such as main text with commentary. Do not infer author, work, date, or provenance.
A tight crop may not show the layout; say so rather than guessing.

Use those features to choose a few useful spans: headings or question openings,
then connecting prose, transitions or citation chains. Keep quoted lemmata and
commentary separate. Read enough surrounding prose to make a later source match
checkable; a full transcription is not required. State which areas you selected
and which remain unread. Suggest a wider view or an adjacent crop if needed.

Transcribe those spans, preserving physical lines. Label each line with its
image filename and a line number counted from the top of that image. Keep columns
and marginal additions separate. Note overlapping crops rather than treating
repeated lines as additional text.

Retain abbreviation marks when possible. Put proposed expansions in parentheses,
uncertain readings before a question mark, and unreadable text in [illegible].
Describe visible deletions and additions explicitly. Do not supply missing words
from what would make grammatical or philosophical sense. Leave uncertainty visible.

Return the reading as UTF-8 plain text. Include limitations (cropped lines, damage,
uncertain column order) in that same response. This is an unverified image reading.

text:
PACKET-12 - unverified image-only reading

EXPOSURE / PROCEDURE STATEMENT
- Nothing in my context revealed a proposed identification or reading of this fragment. This is a blind reading.
- Beyond the stated rules: I listed the packet directory to learn image filenames (packet.json not opened) and made enlarged grayscale/auto-contrast crops of the tiles in my scratchpad. No web, search, edition or catalogue consulted.

LAYOUT SURVEY (observations)
- Three overview views: image-001 (a binding/pastedown area with a horizontal manuscript strip along the bottom), image-004 (a different board/pastedown, with a horizontal strip along the bottom edge), image-008 (a third view: board with a strip along the bottom, plus a pasted-on paper/parchment label with faint cursive). Tiles: image-002 and image-003 = native-resolution views of the strip in image-001 (left half and right half; they overlap in the middle around the "on q alt(eru)m" column); image-005, image-006, image-007 = native views of the strip in image-004 (left, middle, right; overlapping); image-009 = native view of the faint inscription on the label in image-008.
- Each manuscript strip is a horizontal band (c. 1.3-1.5 cm tall) cut across a leaf, so it preserves 3 lines from each of up to 4 columns of a multi-column page, with intercolumn spaces. Lines are cut at top and bottom of the strip (top line often partly clipped). The strips are folded/hinged into the binding and fixed with leather/tawed thongs that obscure a few words.
- Script: early gothic / late protogothic book hand (textualis), brown ink, moderate abbreviation, clear letter forms. No rubrics or initials visible. A paragraph-like mark "S;" plus "xx." at image-002 l.2 col. 1 (possibly a section/number marker). Interlinear additions over several words (e.g. "ou" above "on" in image-003 col. 1 l.1).
- Marginal/annotation: in image-007 (strip of image-004), between col. 3 and col. 4 there are wavy guide strokes ("nos ~~~~" and a long connector line) linking a word in the margin to text; in image-006 col. 3 l.3 a marginal "gl(osa)?"-type word ("crdii"?, "eodem"?) sits left of "vt" with a wavy line. These look like reference/linking marks (interpretation).
- Above the strip in image-001 the blank pastedown carries later cursive pen trials / notes in a different, more cursive hand ("6 Julij ...", "absolut", "Mag(ister?)..."); these are not part of the strip text and I read only fragments. The label in image-008/009 has a faint later cursive inscription, largely unreadable.
- Tentative interpretation: canon-law or theological text (vocabulary of election, "licentia", "uxori", "consuetudo", "sacramenta"); interpretation only.

LIMITATIONS
- Only three lines per column survive in each strip, cut above and below; first/last lines are partly clipped. Thongs cover words in image-002/005/007. Column order within each strip is left-to-right as photographed; whether columns are a/b of one page or across an opening is not determinable from these images.
- Line numbers count from the top of each tile; I label columns col.1, col.2, ... left to right within each tile.

SPANS SELECTED: all legible text on both strips (everything in image-002/003 and image-005/006/007). The later notes in image-001 (above strip) and image-009 are only partly read.

TRANSCRIPTION

== Strip 1 (overview image-001), tiles image-002 (left) and image-003 (right) ==
image-002 col.1 l.1   ...abrogant[?]  e(?)ps addit[?] p(er)g(?)dimit[?].     (top of line partly clipped; first letters "ab" uncertain)
image-002 col.1 l.2   S; xx. Nonne q(uo)d p(ri)ncipi placuit leg(is)
image-002 col.1 l.3   h(abe)t uigore(m) [thong covers c. 1-2 letters/word] n(on) op(us) e(st) i(n) ...tomem[?] pacte[?].     (the word before "pacte" may be "somem"/"nomen"; very uncertain)
image-002 col.2 l.1   [...]rale censetur. figurat[?]ua n(on) c(on)tinu(m)[?] ad     (interlinear "u"/"o" above "n(on)")
image-002 col.2 l.2   suf(fi)ci(enti)e[?] s(ed)[?] de ie(?) c(on)stonis[?] q(uo) ad mist(er)i(um)[?]     (word after "de" has abbreviation marks; read "ie" with superscript)
image-002 col.2 l.3   intellect(us) ... iure n(on) sacrificia.     (dot/hole after "intellectu")
image-003 col.1 l.1   on q(uod) alt(eru)m eligi neq(ui)t. Electio na(m)q(ue)     (interlinear "ou" above "on")
image-003 col.1 l.2   ...de de eligendis d(icitu)r. dicam(us)[?] t(ame)n n(on) det(ur)     (interlinear "a"/"a" above "det")
image-003 col.1 l.3   licentia uerbis. q(uod) uxori suadeat
image-003 col.2 l.1   ...xxvi[?]. q. ii[?] ...p(er) ... ...     (top line clipped; mostly unread)
image-003 col.2 l.2   ...e[?] si dedit ei licentia(m) t(ra)nsfretandi. ibi[?]/ubi[?]     (interlinear mark above "licentia")
image-003 col.2 l.3   die(m) su(u)m fungat(ur)[?] cu(m) h(ec)[?] uxori c(on)tinu[?]...     (interlinear "s" above "uxori"; end of line cut)
Left-edge traces at image-003 far left: "...o", "...", "...u" (end of col. 2 of image-002 lines; overlap).

== Strip 2 (overview image-004), tiles image-005 (left), image-006 (middle), image-007 (right) ==
image-005 col.1 l.1   ...in[?] p(ro)fectio[?] c(on)uenerit q(ue) corp(us) ei(us) sol-     (top line partly clipped; a large descender/flourish from line above)
image-005 col.1 l.2   ...lep(?)ni[?] uoto anne(x)u(m). S(ed) h(ab)itu(m) ...     (thong begins after "h(ab)itu(m)")
image-005 col.1 l.3   [...]sterio[?] i(n)duit. Ac si p(ost) m[...] [thong] eius
image-005 col.2 l.1 (= image-006 col.1 l.1)   t n(on). h(oc) t(ame)n si oppr(es)sa fuisset[?] siti[?]/sibi n(on) attendit
image-005 col.2 l.2 (= image-006 col.1 l.2)   ...uit a te t ab alio dum in c(on)stat[?] (et?) ...cor
image-005 col.2 l.3 (= image-006 col.1 l.3)   ...rupta. ve(l) xxxii. q. v. Ille ...      (last word "feci"[?]/"sten"[?])
image-006 col.2 l.1   t nup(er)rime p(ro)mulgata. ...
image-006 col.2 l.2   hu(m)ana c(on)stit(uti)o[?] sep(?) t n(on) sc(?)p. ...     (abbreviated "sep."/"scip." repeated; possibly "scripta ... non scripta")
image-006 col.2 l.3   [marginal "eodem"[?] with wavy line] vt hu(m)an(us)[?] g(e)n(us)[?] d(icitu)r. n(on) ie(?) n(on) ...     (interlinear marks above "g(e)n(us)", "d(icitu)r", "ie")
image-007 col.1 l.1   ...ne p(ro)mulgata. Nam.     (= image-006 col.2 l.1 end)
image-007 col.1 l.2   ...o sep(?) t n(on) scp. loge[?] t nup(?) p(ro)mlt(?).     (the word after "scp." could be "lege")
image-007 col.1 l.3   ...g(e)n(us) d(icitu)r. n(on)[?] ie[?] n... moribus.     (hole in parchment mid-line)
image-007 col.2 l.1   nos[ ~~~~ wavy connector ] ...dept[?] z d(icitu)r[?] con(?)ido[?].     (first word "nos" sits in the intercolumn with a long wavy line)
image-007 col.2 l.2   [long connector stroke] ...u sep(?)t z d(icitu)r c(on)suetudo.
image-007 col.2 l.3   (no text visible below; thong at right)

Uncertainty note for strip 2 col.2 lines in image-007: I read "...dept z dr con(...)do" and "...sept z dr (con)suetudo"; the first word of each could be "Scripta"/"Dicta"; I did not supply this.

== Later notes on the pastedown (image-001, above strip; different hand, not part of the strip) ==
image-001 upper left, vertical-ish lines: "6 Julij[?]" / "Mag(?) ... absolut" / "Mag(?) ... dat ..."     [cursive, low confidence]

== Label inscription (image-009, from overview image-008) ==
image-009 l.1   ...con[?] ...ad ... ... ...Hans[?]/Thys[?]
image-009 l.2   ...[illegible] ...q(?)ui ... ...
Largely illegible faded cursive; not attempted further.

MOST SECURE READINGS FOR A LATER MATCH
"Nonne q(uo)d p(ri)ncipi placuit leg(is) h(abe)t uigore(m)" (002 col.1 ll.2-3); "...rale censetur" (002 col.2 l.1); "iure n(on) sacrificia" (002 col.2 l.3); "q(uod) alt(eru)m eligi neq(ui)t. Electio na(m)q(ue)" (003 col.1 l.1); "de eligendis d(icitu)r" (003 col.1 l.2); "licentia uerbis. q(uod) uxori suadeat" (003 col.1 l.3); "si dedit ei licentia(m) t(ra)nsfretandi" (003 col.2 l.2); "uoto anne(x)u(m). S(ed) h(ab)itu(m)" (005 col.1 l.2); "...sterio i(n)duit. Ac si p(ost)" (005 col.1 l.3); "xxxii. q. v." (005/006 col.2 l.3); "nup(er)rime p(ro)mulgata" (006); "hu(m)ana c(on)stit(uti)o" (006); "moribus" (007); "c(on)suetudo" (007).

SUGGESTIONS
The strips are hinges; their hidden turn-ins (folded under the boards) likely carry more lines. Imaging the reverse/turn-in, and raking light on the label in image-008, would add text.
